success_moves: Reuse existing dependency focus and layout instead of another renderer.

milestones.title: Architecture observations explain their original edges
milestones.outcome: Cycle and degree observations preserve original edges and completeness in the existing focus view.
milestones.proof: TS/Python cycle/type-only/barrel/lazy/unresolved fixtures, configuration invalidation and existing geometry tests.

milestones.outcome: One typed report joins rule evidence without running a new engine.

cut_line: Test/mutation runners, hosted analysis, embedded clone engines and rule-pack redistribution.
Full call graphs, a replacement graph renderer, and dependency matrices without a failed focus task.
Mutation evidence until an existing targeted report shows a missed assertion beyond coverage.
Boundary rules until the project supplies a concrete allowed/forbidden relationship.
Trends, general plugin infrastructure and support for multiple artifact versions at once.
